prompt:
The visual shows a brick-breaker playfield with labeled bricks at the top, a short ball-direction cue, and labeled catch lanes at the bottom. The short dashed arrow shows the ball's current straight direction. Which labeled brick will the ball hit first?
Final answer format: set "answer" to the selected brick label as a string.
Annotation format: set "annotation" to one bounding box [x0, y0, x1, y1] around the brick hit first after extrapolating the ball direction.
Example JSON:
{"annotation":[[438,186,514,228]],"answer":"H"}
